and select the correct answer for the given blank out of the four alternatives.

long term average.

region and inversely proportional to its heat capacity. While the radiation (4) ______ may
dominate the average energy budget of many surfaces, nonradiative energy transfer and
storage also are (5) ______ important when local changes are considered.
